summary: research/notes/IOS-003-kernel-readiness-matrix.md: 21-row matrix (R01-R21) of what the donor projects needed in the kernel/root to run iOS 16.x userland, against the project kernel (xnu-8796.121.2 DEVELOPMENT_ARM64_E1S + HackiOS redwood.patch + files/ overlay + e1s patches). Five donors pinned at full SHAs and read at the file level (ios-apollo, s24-port, hakios, y2sios, ios-lemonadep); y2sios (same xnu-8796.121.2, iOS 16.5 userland, Exynos 990, recovery-partition boot, 2.32 GiB resident APFS root) is the closest donor. Project state per row uses only: in S24 log / in image / in source / absent / unknown. Ordered list: (1) a listable Apple root on the host, (2) a way to deliver a ~2.3 GB root into RAM without an Android partition (project loader has no host-to-device bulk path), (3) a session longer than ~8 s (watchdog), (4) kernel mounting the root, (5) stand-ins answering Apple's launchd. The note says nowhere that Apple's launchd, dyld or any iOS root runs on the S24.
